payload.title: An open reading holds its question's decision, and the next Hypothesis while the work rests on it
payload.body:
The owner's rule for #174 (2026-11-14): a reading holds the decision, not the work. An open reading holds its question's select, choose and reaffirm, whatever its reach. It holds the question's next Hypothesis while its answer can move a live Hypothesis there, or while no open limit that a Result on the question recorded is unreferred, and it holds the undecided item of a Hypothesis its Result judged inconclusive. Holding the decision does not mean the runner builds on a guess while a line is unclear. Replay derives every hold from the log; nothing new is stored.

Event: in run 4 of record:G-SZCBXZ, record:R-V2CMZQ supported h-record-9 and recorded reading record:R-V2CMZQ#r1. The runner then added h-record-10b while OWED owed it nothing. The supersede left the reading with an empty reach, so it held nothing.

Words: Q is a DesignQuestion. A Result on Q is a non-retracted Result whose Experiment's nearest question is Q, and a reading on Q is a reading of a Result on Q. A Hypothesis a reading's answer can move is a live one whose parent is Q, that the reading's Result judged, and that is supported now, inconclusive now when that Result's verdict on it was inconclusive, whatever other Results judged (line 2), or contradicted with that Result as its only contradiction.

The Goal does not ask about an answered question: an open reading changes no question's state and no Goal's state. It does not ask about hyp retract: a retracted Result's readings hold nothing. Lines 4 and 5 hold on the base, commit afe2c1f1e9cad835edb755b6c08deaae279afd1b.

The same PR updates docs/replay-spec.md (section 4 readings, 5, 5.1, 7.3 and 8.1), docs/glossary.md (the rivals, undecided and stale rows, and a new entry for reaffirm), docs/owner-guide.md, skills/hyp-prototype and skills/hyp-goal-run, which no longer copies a reading onto a later Result by hand.

May change: this repository, by commits on one local branch feat/reading-hold and a PR the run never merges
May change: internal/, cmd/, docs/ and skills/
Read only: every other store under investigations/
Never: replace the installed hyp binary

lines.text: [N] On an open or reopened DesignQuestion Q with an open reading on Q, whatever Hypotheses its Result judged and their status now, and also when that Result's Experiment has no targets: hyp status owes no select, choose or stale item on Q, and hyp select of a Hypothesis whose parent is Q, and hyp reaffirm of Q or of such a Hypothesis, exit 1, the refusal naming the first thing Q's turn waits on. Replay still applies such an event from a merged log.

[P] On an open or reopened DesignQuestion Q, a live Hypothesis whose parent is Q, whose status is inconclusive now, and that a Result with an open reading on Q judged inconclusive, is one that reading's answer can move: hyp status owes no undecided item on it, and line 2 changes no planned item. Any other live inconclusive Hypothesis under an open or reopened question, with no planned Experiment that has it as parent or target, is owed undecided.

[N] On an open or reopened DesignQuestion Q with one or more open readings on Q, while the answer of one of them can move a live Hypothesis there, or no open limit that a Result on Q recorded is unreferred: hyp status owes no rivals item on Q; hyp add hyp --parent Q exits 1 unless hyp status owes a premise item on Q; and hyp supersede --old H and hyp abandon H exit 1 for each H an open reading on Q can move, unless H is the candidate a premise item names. Each refusal names an open reading on Q. A Goal line is not a limit a Result recorded. Replay still applies such an event from a merged log.

[P] When every open reading on an open or reopened DesignQuestion Q has an answer that can move no live Hypothesis there, and an open limit that any Result on Q recorded is unreferred, including one the owner returned, hyp add hyp --parent Q succeeds, and Q, with no rival, owes rivals.
[P] When the owner has answered every reading on Q, lines 1 to 4 hold nothing on Q, and hyp status owes the runner an apply answer item for each answered reading that no Result applies.

[P] When the first thing Q's turn waits on is an open reading whose answer can move no Hypothesis there, the waits line for that reading under Q in hyp status and the hyp select refusal name the reading, say that it holds Q's decision, and name no Hypothesis as one the answer can move.

why: The owner's grill of #174 on 2026-11-14: the hold rule as a build Goal.
